4653.d: Burgh de Rott (pronounced "Bur-der-rot") is a ramshackle town located in the southernmost part of Morytania that serves as the base for the Myreque rebels.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The games necklace can be used to teleport to Burgh de Rott with the completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale quest and having 500 companion levels in Temple Trekking.
• After levelling Zachory Bragg to level 99 in Temple Trekking the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis takes players directly to Mort'ton.
• Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• A Swamp Boat can be taken nearby to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp. The boat can be reached by the following methods:
• Run south from Canifis (with a shortcut via the tunnel behind the Hair of the Dog tavern after In Search of the Myreque).
• Fairy ring code BKR to Mort Myre Swamp.
• Players with at least 1 Barrows kill can use a Boss portal, attuned to the Barrows to teleport there, arriving at the Northeast of Burgh de Rott.
• Running from Canifis, while slow, has no requirements.

4682.d: Burthorpe is a military principality north-west of Falador and north of Taverley and is currently the base of the Burthorpe Imperial Guard as well as the residence of Crown Prince Anlaf, the son of King Vallance.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
All players
• Teleport directly to the Burthorpe lodestone.
• Teleport to the Taverley lodestone or use the House Teleport spell to the Taverley POH portal (if the player has a house there) and walk north.
• Teleport to the Troll Invasion Distraction and Diversion by using the games necklace.

Members only
• Teleport just outside the Warriors' Guild by using the combat bracelet.
• Players with 99 Slayer can use the Slayer cape perk to teleport to Turael (or Spria, after While Guthix Sleeps), who stands directly north of the Burthorpe bank near the Warriors' Guild.

gt.heading: Entrances
gt.text:
Burthorpe can be entered either from Taverley to the south, or from Death Plateau to the north-west.
The games necklace provides a teleport to the Troll Invasion activity, and the Combat bracelet can teleport to just outside the Warriors' Guild.

4777.d: Butterflies are non-interactive characters that can be found flying around in a variety of places around RuneScape.
